name: Southstone Minerals Limited
summary: Southstone Minerals Limited functions as a junior mining enterprise, concentrating its efforts on identifying, assessing, and advancing mineral deposits across Canada. In addition to its Canadian endeavors, the company maintains a stake in the Oena Diamond Mine, a notable alluvial diamond operation located in South Africa's Northern Cape Province. Incorporated in 2007 and based out of Victoria, Canada, the firm was formerly known as Tango Mining Limited until its rebranding to Southstone Minerals Limited in October 2019.
